audit.method: Deterministic stratified sampling plus full-corpus heuristic ranking. Repairs require a clear learner-facing defect and a higher-confidence replacement; a heuristic flag alone is not sufficient.

頃.equation: Visual comparison: 匕 ancient spoon + 頁 head = 頃 around
頃.mnemonic: A falling 匕 ancient spoon clatters behind a 頁 head, making it turn 頃 around.
頃.hero_image_prompt: A metal spoon clattering to the floor behind a person whose head turns around toward the sound, no text or labels.
頃.rationale: Prioritizes the common Japanese time/approximation sense over the rare land unit and replaces a head counting one hundred fields with the visible left-and-right grouping.

夊.mnemonic: The upper bend is a knee, and the long final stroke drags behind like a 夊 trailing foot.
夊.hero_image_prompt: A slow walking foot trailing behind with the leg bent at the knee, simple educational ink illustration, no text.
夊.rationale: Replaces the catalog metadata gloss 'shape mark 35' with the historically useful component image learners actually need.

婦.equation: Historical image: 女 woman + 帚 broom = 婦 married woman
婦.mnemonic: In this traditional image, a 女 woman holding the household 帚 broom is a 婦 married woman.
婦.hero_image_prompt: A respectfully framed historical household scene with an adult married woman holding a traditional straw broom, museum illustration, no text.
婦.rationale: The prior story put the broom away and then introduced a second married woman. Historical framing makes the old convention explicit without presenting it as a modern rule.

員.equation: 口 mouth + 貝 shell = 員 employee
員.mnemonic: At payroll, a 口 mouth calls each name before paying a 貝 shell to one 員 employee.
員.hero_image_prompt: An old payroll window where a clerk calls a name and pays one worker with a shell coin, no text or labels.
員.rationale: Moves the answer out of the setup and lets the two visible components identify one employee through a concrete payroll action.

演.equation: 氵 water (drops) + 寅 sign of the tiger = 演 perform
演.mnemonic: Onstage, 氵 water ripples around the 寅 sign of the tiger as dancers 演 perform.
演.hero_image_prompt: Dancers performing onstage around rippling water beneath a tiger zodiac emblem, no text or app UI.
演.rationale: Removes the unsupported claim that splashing water and wearing a tiger sign somehow help an actor perform; the components now define the stage scene.

県.equation: Visual comparison: 目 eye + 小 small = 県 county
県.mnemonic: A 目 eye surveys each 小 small region on the map to find one 県 county.
県.hero_image_prompt: An eye surveying small outlined regions on a map and focusing on one county, no writing, text, or labels.
県.rationale: Replaces five tiny IDS fragments with the two salient modern shapes visible to a Japanese learner.

燕.mnemonic: The ancient form pictures a beak, spread wings, and forked tail as an 燕 swallow.
燕.hero_image_prompt: An ancient pictographic swallow with a visible beak, two spread wings, and a forked tail, educational ink illustration, no text.
燕.rationale: Restores the attested whole-character bird image instead of making a swallow lead twenty birds north with a fiery tail.

㷼.equation: Variant of 燕 swallow: 㷼 swallow
㷼.mnemonic: The old variant 㷼 swallow preserves the beak, spread wings, and forked tail of 燕 swallow.
㷼.hero_image_prompt: Two historical written forms beside the same swallow silhouette with beak, spread wings, and forked tail, no text.
㷼.rationale: Uses the officially recorded variant relationship instead of inventing a northbound flock fleeing a fire.

鷰.equation: Variant of 燕 swallow: 鷰 swallow
鷰.mnemonic: The old variant 鷰 swallow preserves the beak, spread wings, and forked tail of 燕 swallow.
鷰.hero_image_prompt: Two historical written forms beside the same swallow silhouette with beak, spread wings, and forked tail, no text.
鷰.rationale: Uses the officially recorded variant relationship instead of enumerating a bird plus four unrelated fragments.
